name: (05) Obeah — 3 Advanced — Unburdening the Bestial Soul

system.description:
Perhaps the most miraculous gift of Obeah, this power draws a tormented soul into communion with your own, soothing the psychic scars of the Curse and easing the weight of the Beast.

The subject must be willing and you must hold eye contact; then make a Static Physical Challenge against a difficulty of two Traits for every Humanity or Path Trait the subject falls below six, retested with Medicine. It functions only on vampires with Humanity, or on the Paths of Harmony or Honorable Accord, and never on one with no Humanity/Path Traits left. While you hold the soul the subject's body is empty of consciousness. You may then expend permanent Willpower Traits to restore Humanity or Path Traits Trait-for-Trait, up to the normal maximum of five. You cannot restore your own.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
